definitions.explanation: The quality of thinking and acting on one's own without being told or directed by others. Valued in education and the workplace as a sign of maturity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自主性|じしゅせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自主性|じしゅせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I want to work at a company that respects employees' initiative.

examples.japanese: {自主性|じしゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まとまらない→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Just leaving things to people's initiative sometimes isn't enough to bring a team together.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{自主|じしゅ}→自主：13979_jishu⟧ (self-directed, voluntary) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). Describes the personal quality of being able to act and decide independently. Central to Japanese educational philosophy, especially in discussions about child-rearing and school culture.

USAGE:
Very common in education, parenting, and business contexts. Often paired with verbs like ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to cultivate), ⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧ (to respect), and ⟦{重|おも}んじる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧ (to value). Frequently contrasted with situations where people only follow instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自主性|じしゅせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ — to foster independence
- {自主性|じしゅせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧ — to respect autonomy
- {自主性|じしゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ — to leave to someone's initiative
- {自主性|じしゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ — to lack initiative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主体性|しゅたいせい}→主体性：16041_shutaisei⟧ — agency, proactiveness (stronger emphasis on being the driving force)
- ⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧ — self-reliance, independence (more about practical self-sufficiency)
- {自発性|じはつせい} — spontaneity, voluntariness (emphasis on doing things without prompting)
